entries.title: A figure on a card can move when that explains it better
entries.body: A figure that explains a change over time, such as a queue or events in order, now plays when you press its button. A figure that shows a value you might change, such as a width or a moment, has one control that redraws it. Every other figure stays still, nothing moves until you press or drag, and with reduced motion each move happens at once. A revised card still marks what changed beside a moving figure.
entries.noPicture: A still picture cannot show a figure moving on a press, and only cards written after this change carry one.
